main_argument_chains.claim: Wordle score-sharing spread follows epidemiological dynamics with a loyal-player extension.
support_steps: Manual EDA identifies epidemic-like shape (steep rise, long-tailed decline).
SIR model reviewed and mapped to game domain (S→Potential, I→Crowd, R→Quitted).
PCQL extends SIR by adding Loyal compartment for habitual players.
GA + Nelder-Mead optimize parameters; Bootstrap provides 95% prediction interval.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Predicted 14121 reports on March 1 2023 with 95% CI [11173, 17069], confirming plateau phase.

main_argument_chains.claim: Word attributes do NOT cause Hard Mode percentage variation.
support_steps: Covariance matrix screens for correlated features.
Near-zero R² interpreted as no meaningful explanatory power.
Temporal confound argument: both predictor and response trend with time.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Null result: apparent correlation is spurious, driven by game lifecycle dynamics.

main_argument_chains.claim: Word features predict try distribution via KNN regression with sum-preservation.
support_steps: Character-level features (regularity, purity) engineered from Markov chain assumption.
Covariance matrix pre-screens features; 10-fold CV selects K=15 and feature subset.
KNN regression preserves sum-to-100% constraint by construction.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Distributional prediction for any word, with honest uncertainty bounds.

main_argument_chains.claim: Words can be classified into 3 difficulty levels with 75% accuracy.
support_steps: Difficulty operationalized via median try count (3=easy, 4=normal, 5-6=hard).
Sparse median-6 group merged with median-5 for viable classification.
Covariance-based feature screening selects repeated letters, weighted purity, weighted regularity.
KNN classifier (K=8) achieves 75.28% accuracy with CI [63.16%, 82.76%].
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: EERIE classified as ordinary (normal) difficulty. Classification is viable but not highly precise.

warnings.warning: PCQL model page shows transition diagram but symbolic labels are partially illegible.
Fitted parameters alpha=0.177, beta=0.0177, gamma=0.00104, delta=0.00114 presented without confidence intervals.
Bootstrap interval [11173, 17069] is very wide (53% of midpoint).
Regression statistically significant (p=0.005) but practically negligible (R²=0.022).
KNN MSE=12.35 reported without units or baseline comparison.
